question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin now, or should this issue wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before it is considered solved?
rationale: The request is coherent and has an open implementation candidate, but the source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision automation should not choose.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its proof, storage, security, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 settles a richer `sessions.activity.*` API, then implement the widget against that contract.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing, but only after this issue's unique status-widget requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate UI solution while requiring its proof, storage, security, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the plugin-tab seam and is the strongest routing signal for accepting dashboard product shape, with vincentkoc adjacent for the Gateway activity contract.
